0212 'owphan {o:-fan'} 或 (縮寫型) 'ophan {o:-fan'}

字根已不使用, 意為"旋轉"; TWOT - 146a; 陽性名詞

欽定本 - wheel(s) 35, fitly 1; 36

1) 輪子
   1a) 戰車的輪子
   1b) 以西結的異象中的四輪
   1c) 所羅門聖殿, 盆座的銅輪

0212 'owphan {o-fawn'} or (shortened) 'ophan {o-fawn'}

from an unused root meaning to revolve; TWOT - 146a; n m

AV - wheel(s) 35, fitly 1; 36

1) wheel
   1a) chariot wheel
   1b) wheel in Ezekiel's vision
   1c) wheels of the ten bases beneath the lavers in Solomon's temple
